topics.description: Recent articles highlight a significant fraud case in Minnesota where a personal care assistant was accused of billing Medicaid $116K for services not provided. The case has garnered attention due to its large sum and the sentencing of the woman involved.
topics.reason: The large sum of $116K and the nearly 42-year prison sentence
